cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Content Specialist position at Materialise. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I have developed a unique ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging content that resonates with diverse audiences. Your description of content as 'more than words on a page' deeply resonates with me—I see content as a strategic tool to build authority, engage audiences, and drive action.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have been responsible for on-page SEO and content creation for client websites. I regularly interview technical experts to extract key information and craft it into keyword-targeted blog posts and web copy that improve organic visibility. This experience has sharpened my interviewing and listening skills, as well as my ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.

My technical foundation sets me apart. I have hands-on experience with WordPress, Elementor, and structured data implementation (JSON-LD schema) on my own project, mirook.com, where I improved visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This understanding of the technical side of content allows me to collaborate effectively with digital marketing colleagues and optimize content for search engines.

I am particularly drawn to Materialise because of its people-centered culture and its mission to build a better and healthier world. I am a proactive, growth-minded individual who thrives in fast-paced, innovative environments. My experience in the healthcare sector (ViviDoctor) and my current work in tech have prepared me to handle the complexities of your products and services.

I am eager to bring my editorial instinct, technical savvy, and collaborative spirit to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Materialise's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
